title: readings totally off
symptom: After replacing a Libre sensor, readings are completely off by about 30 or 40 compared to blood testing and the Libre scanner, despite initial and several calibrations during the day. The user noticed more problems since the latest update.
fix: The user reset the xDrip app completely (Android data delete) and it seemed a little better, but the thread does not confirm a definitive fix.
evidence_quote: now after resetting the xdrip app completely (android data delete, strangely enough no cache data) seems a little better.
